question: What was the literacy rate of India as per the 1951 Census?
solution:
The correct answer is __**18.33%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** percentage of adults who are literate** in a given country, territory, or geographic area who are 15 years of age or older, expressed as a** percentage of the corresponding population **overall or for a particular sex, at a particular moment, typically mid-year. 
 
• India had an** 18.33% literacy rate in 1951**. According to the** 2011 Census, the nation's literacy rate was 74.04%.**
 
• In 1951, only** 9% of women in the nation **were literate.
 
• The country's overall literacy rate rose from **18.33% in 1951 to 65.38% in 2001**, with male literacy rates standing at **75.65% and female literacy rates at 54.16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​​**India's 2021 literacy rate is 74.04%. **According to Census 2021, the literacy rates for men are** 82.14% and for women are 65.46%. **
 
• In the** six decades since Partition, India's population **has more than tripled, rising from 361 million (36.1 crores) in the 1951 census to more than **1.2 billion (120 crores) in 2011.**
 
• According to the** National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5) **and National Statistical Office: NSO, the literacy rate is 77.70%, with literate males at 84.70% and** literate females at 70.30%. (2021 and 2022).**
